fullPassage: Even a seemingly simple protocol such as greeting someone is coded socially. It is shaped by appropriate words, phrases, and nonverbal cues that will enable a speaker to make successful social contact with another speaker. Consider, for the sake of argument, a simple greeting protocol such as "Hi!" As such, it reveals the kind of coded behavior that is relevant in the society in which it occurs, since there are other societies in which silence or a simple nod of the head may be more appropriate as a protocol. Also, the shortened word rather than the full word "Hello!" implies a social relation of a specific kind (informal) between the interlocutors, implying as well that they are involved in similar life schemes, which impel them to make contact in this ritualistic way. Unconscious factors such as these are imprinted in that one simple protocol, thus connecting it to larger frames of meaning and interaction. These frames are coded socially — they constitute ways of relating to others and to oneself. The information exchanged in that one protocol, therefore, goes well beyond a greeting. As this example shows in microcosm, social codes derive from traditions and are taught via rearing practices.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a set of rules or established methods of procedure for conducting affairs"

det.korean: 업무를 수행하기 위한 규칙 또는 확립된 절차의 체계
det.analysis:
① tradition: 전통 → 규칙/절차 체계가 아닌 관습 전달 의미
② interaction: 상호작용 → 사람 간 교류 의미로 부적합
③ protocol: 규약, 절차 → 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
④ scheme: 계획, 방안 → 절차 체계보다 계획/구상 의미
det.tip: protocol=규약, 절차 (a set of rules for conducting affairs)

questions.passage: Also, the __________ (shorten) word rather than the full word "Hello!" implies a social relation of a specific kind (informal) between the interlocutors, implying as well that they are involved in similar life schemes, which impel them to make contact in this ritualistic way.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: the와 word 사이에서 명사 word를 수식하는 과거분사 역할이 필요하므로 shorten → shortened

questions.passage: Unconscious factors such as these are imprinted in that one simple protocol, thus connecting it to larger frames of __________ (mean) and interaction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 전치사 of 뒤에 명사 역할이 필요하므로 mean → meaning(의미). interaction과 병렬 구조
det.tip: 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사(형) 필요: meaning=의미

questions.passage: Even a seemingly simple protocol such as greeting someone is coded socially. It is shaped by appropriate words, phrases, and nonverbal cues that will enable a speaker to make successful social contact with another speaker. Consider, __________, a simple greeting protocol such as "Hi!" As such, it reveals the kind of coded behavior that is relevant in the society in which it occurs, since there are other societies in which silence or a simple nod of the head may be more appropriate as a protocol. Also, the shortened word rather than the full word "Hello!" implies a social relation of a specific kind (informal) between the interlocutors, implying as well that they are involved in similar life schemes, which impel them to make contact in this ritualistic way. Unconscious factors such as these are imprinted in that one simple protocol, thus connecting it to larger frames of meaning and interaction. These frames are coded socially — they constitute ways of relating to others and to oneself. The information exchanged in that one protocol, therefore, goes well beyond a greeting. As this example shows in microcosm, social codes derive from traditions and are taught via rearing practices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 논의를 위해 'Hi!'와 같은 인사를 생각해보라는 맥락
det.analysis:
① for the sake of argument: 논의를 위해 → 원문 정확 일치 ←정답
② in this ritualistic way: 이 의례적 방식으로 → 글 중반 맥락이며 빈칸 위치 부적합
③ well beyond a greeting: 인사를 훨씬 넘어서 → 글 후반 정보 교환 맥락
④ via rearing practices: 양육 관행을 통해 → 글 마지막 문장 맥락
det.tip: for the sake of argument=논의를 위해
